name: Jitters
summary: In western Duskwood, Jitters shelters alone among Raven Hill's ruins. He depends on travelers for food and watches the shadows for danger.

sections.title: A Haunted Hermit
sections.body: At Raven Hill, Jitters fears the predators along Duskwood's western trails. He depends on travelers for food and keeps watch for danger. Long ago, his habit of flinching and leaping clear of sudden threats earned him his name. The fear comes from horrors he faced himself.

sections.title: The Awakening at Roland's Doom
sections.body: Jitters once belonged to the Defias Brotherhood, who came into Duskwood. While digging at Roland's Doom, he found the Scythe of Elune jutting from the rock. The artifact brought fierce, bloodthirsty worgen into the woods. Jitters watched his comrades die beneath their claws and barely escaped alive.

sections.title: Flight and the Farmstead
sections.body: After fleeing the mine, Jitters went to Darkshire. He bought a blank tome from Clerk Daltry and wrote down the nightmare while hiding in the Scarlet Raven Tavern. Panicked, he took shelter in a barn at the Yorgen Farmstead. There, black-cloaked Dark Riders killed Sven Yorgen's family as they searched for the Scythe. Afraid of blame and discovery, Jitters buried pages of his journal in the soil, then fled to Raven Hill with guilt and dread close behind.

faq.answer: Jitters is a frightened human who lives among Raven Hill's ruins. He is hungry, alone, and haunted by what he has experienced in Duskwood.

aliases: where did his name come from
faq.answer: Jitters earned his name from wary habits: he flinched from blows and leapt clear of sudden pitfalls. His isolation and fear in Duskwood have made him more nervous.

faq.q: What danger do the worgen pose in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Worgen stalk Duskwood's woods and roads. They threaten travelers and isolated settlements.

faq.q: What happened to Sven Yorgen's family?
faq.answer: Sven Yorgen's family was murdered at their farmstead. He is determined to discover who was responsible.

faq.q: How can Jitters help Sven Yorgen's investigation?
faq.answer: Jitters' journal records his experiences in Duskwood and may help Sven investigate what happened to his family.
Jitters' journal records his experiences in Duskwood. It is part of the investigation into Raven Hill and Sven Yorgen's family.

angles.text: Jitters shows the human cost of Duskwood's troubles. He lives in fear while the Night Watch struggles to protect its people.
As a rogue, you can recognize Jitters' quick instincts for avoiding danger. They have not spared him from fear and isolation in Duskwood.
